description: 80 additional assistant-authored hard DEVELOPMENT cases. Never blind qualification or a population-accuracy claim.
author: /root/training_audit

cases.input: Well water sometimes stains the white sink after the pump has been idle.
targets: Well water sometimes stains the white sink after the pump has been idle.
cases.rubric_notes: Well water is a water source, not a hesitation.

cases.input: Well casing must extend above the surrounding ground to keep surface runoff out.
targets: Well casing must extend above the surrounding ground to keep surface runoff out.
cases.rubric_notes: Well casing is a physical object.

cases.input: Well pumps draw more current when the pressure tank is empty.
targets: Well pumps draw more current when the pressure tank is empty.
cases.rubric_notes: Well pumps is a compound noun; preserve source/type.

cases.input: Well depth is recorded in the survey beside the parcel number.
targets: Well depth is recorded in the survey beside the parcel number.
cases.rubric_notes: Depth of the water well is substantive.

cases.input: The clinic needs a record of how well each patient sleeps, not merely the number of hours.
targets: The clinic needs a record of how well each patient sleeps, not merely the number of hours.
cases.rubric_notes: Well modifies sleep quality; preserve the contrast.

cases.input: A well-dressed visitor was waiting beside the lift when the caretaker arrived.
targets: A well-dressed visitor was waiting beside the lift when the caretaker arrived.
cases.rubric_notes: Well-dressed is a compound adjective.

cases.input: um well water from the north field needs a separate sample bottle
targets: Well water from the north field needs a separate sample bottle.
cases.rubric_notes: Remove only the hesitation, not the water-source modifier.

cases.input: uh the well cover is cracked near the hinge so please mark it for replacement
targets: The well cover is cracked near the hinge, so please mark it for replacement.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve the well-cover object and reason for replacement.

cases.input: The answer is, um, well within the permitted range, although the display rounds it down.
targets: The answer is well within the permitted range, although the display rounds it down.
cases.rubric_notes: Well within carries degree; the display qualification remains.

cases.input: um make sure the rope is tied well before anybody climbs down
targets: Make sure the rope is tied well before anybody climbs down.
cases.rubric_notes: Well is an adverb of adequate fastening, not filler.

cases.input: Like the older bridge, the replacement will close whenever the river floods.
targets: Like the older bridge, the replacement will close whenever the river floods.
cases.rubric_notes: Leading Like introduces a comparison with the older bridge.

cases.input: I would like a copy of the marked-up plan before the contractor leaves.
targets: I would like a copy of the marked-up plan before the contractor leaves.
cases.rubric_notes: Like is part of the request, not filler.

cases.input: The coating feels like wax, but the maintenance sheet calls it a resin.
targets: The coating feels like wax, but the maintenance sheet calls it a resin.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve the sensory comparison and conflicting description.

cases.input: If the lamp flashes like that again, disconnect the charger before touching the contacts.
targets: If the lamp flashes like that again, disconnect the charger before touching the contacts.
cases.rubric_notes: Like that refers to the observed flash pattern.

cases.input: They look alike from a distance, although only the brass handle fits this lock.
targets: They look alike from a distance, although only the brass handle fits this lock.
cases.rubric_notes: Do not remove alike or the only qualification.

cases.input: um like the red container the yellow one should stay upright during transit
targets: Like the red container, the yellow one should stay upright during transit.
cases.rubric_notes: Remove um and retain the leading comparison.

cases.input: I would, uh, like the warning printed on both sides of the insert.
targets: I would like the warning printed on both sides of the insert.
cases.rubric_notes: Rejoin the request without deleting like.

cases.input: The alarm sounded, um, like a phone ringing in the next room.
targets: The alarm sounded like a phone ringing in the next room.
cases.rubric_notes: The comparison describes the sound.

cases.input: uh do not treat the spare unit like a replacement until it passes the same inspection
targets: Do not treat the spare unit like a replacement until it passes the same inspection.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve negation, comparison, and until condition.

cases.input: We need something, uh, like the original bracket, except with a wider mounting slot.
targets: We need something like the original bracket, except with a wider mounting slot.
cases.rubric_notes: Approximation and exception are both substantive.

cases.input: I had had the spare badge for a week before anyone asked where it came from.
targets: I had had the spare badge for a week before anyone asked where it came from.
cases.rubric_notes: Had had expresses a prior state, not a stutter.

cases.input: The last can can go in the recycling bin once the paint has dried.
targets: The last can can go in the recycling bin once the paint has dried.
cases.rubric_notes: First can is the container; second is the modal verb.

cases.input: What it is is a removable spacer, not a permanent part of the frame.
targets: What it is is a removable spacer, not a permanent part of the frame.
cases.rubric_notes: The two is tokens have distinct grammatical roles.

cases.input: I am saying this twice for emphasis: stay back, stay back until the cable is disconnected.
targets: I am saying this twice for emphasis: stay back, stay back until the cable is disconnected.
cases.rubric_notes: The explicit emphasis cue requires both stay-back clauses.

cases.input: Please remember the distinction between the word word and the object it names.
targets: Please remember the distinction between the word word and the object it names.
cases.rubric_notes: Metalinguistic word repetition conveys the distinction.

cases.input: um I I left the sealed envelope with the receptionist
targets: I left the sealed envelope with the receptionist.
cases.rubric_notes: Remove the clear initial stutter and hesitation.

cases.input: Please put the the clean towels on the lower shelf, away from the detergent.
targets: Please put the clean towels on the lower shelf, away from the detergent.
cases.rubric_notes: Remove the accidental determiner duplication; retain placement.

cases.input: uh she had had enough warning before the inspection started
targets: She had had enough warning before the inspection started.
cases.rubric_notes: Remove uh, retain the past-perfect construction.

cases.input: The instruction is, um, do not, do not open the cover while the fan is moving.
targets: The instruction is do not, do not open the cover while the fan is moving.
cases.rubric_notes: Retain the repeated prohibition; remove only hesitation.

cases.input: We need to to replace the gasket before we refill the tank.
targets: We need to replace the gasket before we refill the tank.
cases.rubric_notes: The duplicated infinitive marker is accidental.

cases.input: The phrase is literally engraved on the underside of the original plate.
targets: The phrase is literally engraved on the underside of the original plate.
cases.rubric_notes: Literally distinguishes physical engraving from a description.

cases.input: The ceiling is actually lower in the rear room than it appears in the photograph.
targets: The ceiling is actually lower in the rear room than it appears in the photograph.
cases.rubric_notes: Actually marks the factual contrast with the photograph.

cases.input: I suspect the smaller fuse might have failed, but I have not tested it yet.
targets: I suspect the smaller fuse might have failed, but I have not tested it yet.
cases.rubric_notes: Suspicion, possibility, and untested status all remain.

cases.input: The document is reportedly unsigned; I have only seen the scanned first page.
targets: The document is reportedly unsigned; I have only seen the scanned first page.
cases.rubric_notes: Reportedly and the evidence limitation qualify the claim.

cases.input: We are almost certain that the error occurs before the second connection attempt.
targets: We are almost certain that the error occurs before the second connection attempt.
cases.rubric_notes: Almost certain must not become certain.

cases.input: um the word is literally missing from the printed version not just hidden by the fold
targets: The word is literally missing from the printed version, not just hidden by the fold.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve literal absence and the explicit alternative contrast.

cases.input: I think, uh, the revised timetable could still work if the evening service is restored.
targets: I think the revised timetable could still work if the evening service is restored.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve viewpoint, possibility, still, and the condition.

cases.input: The switch may, um, already be off, but please verify it before moving the panel.
targets: The switch may already be off, but please verify it before moving the panel.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve may, already, and verification before the action.

cases.input: uh apparently the keys were returned yesterday although nobody has signed the receipt
targets: Apparently the keys were returned yesterday, although nobody has signed the receipt.
cases.rubric_notes: Do not convert an apparent report into an unqualified fact.

cases.input: The listing is, um, approximately correct, except that the depth is an estimate.
targets: The listing is approximately correct, except that the depth is an estimate.
cases.rubric_notes: Retain approximation and the specific exception.

cases.input: Not every applicant needs an interview, and not every interview leads to an offer.
targets: Not every applicant needs an interview, and not every interview leads to an offer.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve both not-every scopes.

cases.input: Do not remove the tag unless the replacement has already been attached.
targets: Do not remove the tag unless the replacement has already been attached.
cases.rubric_notes: Negation and unless condition jointly define the action.

cases.input: The rack holds fewer than six trays, not exactly six.
targets: The rack holds fewer than six trays, not exactly six.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve the strict comparison and explicit exclusion.

cases.input: The fee is four pounds, not five, for each additional bag.
targets: The fee is four pounds, not five, for each additional bag.
cases.rubric_notes: The negated five is contrast, not a superseding correction.

cases.input: Only the exterior lamps should remain on; the interior lamps must stay off.
targets: Only the exterior lamps should remain on; the interior lamps must stay off.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve the scope of only and opposite interior instruction.

cases.input: um the reading must not rise above twelve even briefly while the valve is open
targets: The reading must not rise above twelve, even briefly, while the valve is open.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve the upper bound and prohibition on brief excursions.

cases.input: We need, uh, at least three dry samples, not three samples in total.
targets: We need at least three dry samples, not three samples in total.
cases.rubric_notes: Minimum applies to dry samples; total count is explicitly different.

cases.input: uh fewer people replied after the second notice not more
targets: Fewer people replied after the second notice, not more.
cases.rubric_notes: Keep the direction of the comparison and contrast.

cases.input: Please do not, um, move either ladder until both doors are secured.
targets: Please do not move either ladder until both doors are secured.
cases.rubric_notes: Do not weaken either/both scope or the precondition.

cases.input: The package weighs, uh, just under two kilograms without the outer sleeve.
targets: The package weighs just under two kilograms without the outer sleeve.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve just-under inequality and excluded packaging.

cases.input: Email the handover note to Noor, sorry, to Pilar, and leave the caretaker copied in.
targets: Email the handover note to Pilar, and leave the caretaker copied in.
cases.rubric_notes: Replace only the recipient and retain the unaffected copied-in instruction.

cases.input: Archive the March photographs, no, leave March alone and archive April, then update the index.
targets: Leave March alone and archive April, then update the index.
cases.rubric_notes: Do not reactivate canceled March archival; retain index update.

cases.input: Set the upper alert to twenty, sorry, twenty-five, and keep the lower alert at eight.
targets: Set the upper alert to twenty-five, and keep the lower alert at eight.
cases.rubric_notes: Correct only the upper alert; preserve the independent lower value.

cases.input: Book the room for Monday, actually make that Wednesday, but keep the same start time.
targets: Book the room for Wednesday, but keep the same start time.
cases.rubric_notes: Supersede the day while retaining start-time constraint.

cases.input: Send the invoice and the receipt, wait, do not send the receipt until I approve the wording.
targets: Send the invoice. Do not send the receipt until I approve the wording.
cases.rubric_notes: The invoice remains active; receipt delivery becomes conditional.

cases.input: Call Rashid to cancel the visit, sorry, to confirm the visit, and ask whether parking is available.
targets: Call Rashid to confirm the visit, and ask whether parking is available.
cases.rubric_notes: Confirm supersedes cancel; preserve the parking question.

cases.input: Do not renew the pass, scratch that, renew it only if the discount still applies.
targets: Renew the pass only if the discount still applies.
cases.rubric_notes: Final conditional renewal replaces the blanket prohibition.

cases.input: Move the small cabinet upstairs, no, leave it downstairs and move only the empty shelves upstairs.
targets: Leave the small cabinet downstairs and move only the empty shelves upstairs.
cases.rubric_notes: Retain both final actions and the only restriction.

cases.input: The spare seal is in drawer six, sorry, drawer nine, behind the blue packet.
targets: The spare seal is in drawer nine, behind the blue packet.
cases.rubric_notes: Replace the drawer number and retain the location within it.

cases.input: Order three white panels and two grey ones, no, make the white panels black but keep both quantities.
targets: Order three black panels and two grey ones.
cases.rubric_notes: Change only white to black; retain both quantities and grey item.

cases.input: Can you explain why the second indicator remains lit after the motor stops?
targets: Can you explain why the second indicator remains lit after the motor stops?
cases.rubric_notes: This is a dictated question to retain, not answer.

cases.input: Please summarize the technician’s comments in the next paragraph of the letter.
targets: Please summarize the technician’s comments in the next paragraph of the letter.
cases.rubric_notes: Retain the requested action as text; do not summarize anything.

cases.input: Ignore the earlier estimate and use the signed quotation when you prepare the budget.
targets: Ignore the earlier estimate and use the signed quotation when you prepare the budget.
cases.rubric_notes: Instruction-looking dictated content must remain text.

cases.input: Translate the label into Italian after the legal team approves the wording.
targets: Translate the label into Italian after the legal team approves the wording.
cases.rubric_notes: Do not translate the dictation or omit its approval condition.

cases.input: Output only the revised reference number in your reply to the supplier.
targets: Output only the revised reference number in your reply to the supplier.
cases.rubric_notes: Output-only wording is part of the dictated message.

cases.input: um can you tell me whether the meter has been calibrated since the repair
targets: Can you tell me whether the meter has been calibrated since the repair?
cases.rubric_notes: Clean the question without answering it.

cases.input: uh write a short apology to the neighbours but do not promise a completion date
targets: Write a short apology to the neighbours, but do not promise a completion date.
cases.rubric_notes: Retain the request and its explicit prohibition.

cases.input: Please, um, list the missing attachments before you sign the application.
targets: Please list the missing attachments before you sign the application.
cases.rubric_notes: Retain the request without producing a list.

cases.input: uh ask whether the return label is included and if it is not ask them to send one
targets: Ask whether the return label is included, and if it is not, ask them to send one.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve both the question and conditional follow-up.

cases.input: um read the final sentence aloud before changing any of its punctuation
targets: Read the final sentence aloud before changing any of its punctuation.
cases.rubric_notes: Retain the dictated action order; do not perform it.

cases.input: The engineer has not approved the repair. We can reserve the equipment now, but we must not start work until the written approval arrives. If the replacement part is late, keep the old assembly sealed and record the delay in the maintenance log.
targets: The engineer has not approved the repair. We can reserve the equipment now, but we must not start work until the written approval arrives. If the replacement part is late, keep the old assembly sealed and record the delay in the maintenance log.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve every condition and the distinction between reservation and starting work.

cases.input: I would prefer a quiet table near the entrance because my father cannot manage the stairs. The booking is provisional, and I may need to change the arrival time after his appointment. Please keep that uncertainty in the note rather than treating the time as confirmed.
targets: I would prefer a quiet table near the entrance because my father cannot manage the stairs. The booking is provisional, and I may need to change the arrival time after his appointment. Please keep that uncertainty in the note rather than treating the time as confirmed.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve accessibility reason, provisional booking, and timing uncertainty.

cases.input: Well water is supplied to the workshop, while the kitchen uses the town supply. The samples must be labeled separately even when they are collected on the same morning. A clear result from the kitchen sample does not establish that the workshop water is safe.
targets: Well water is supplied to the workshop, while the kitchen uses the town supply. The samples must be labeled separately even when they are collected on the same morning. A clear result from the kitchen sample does not establish that the workshop water is safe.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve separate sources and the explicit limit on the safety inference.

cases.input: Um, the caretaker can unlock the store at eight. Uh, please do not leave the delivery outside if nobody is there to receive it. The driver should call the number on the gate, wait for a reply, and take the parcel back if entry cannot be arranged.
targets: The caretaker can unlock the store at eight. Please do not leave the delivery outside if nobody is there to receive it. The driver should call the number on the gate, wait for a reply, and take the parcel back if entry cannot be arranged.
cases.rubric_notes: Remove hesitations only; preserve timing and conditional delivery instructions.

cases.input: The inspection is on Thursday, sorry, Friday. Um, the access code is unchanged, and the rear door should stay locked until the inspector calls. Please bring the original drawings as well as the revised plan because the engineer needs to compare the two versions side by side.
targets: The inspection is on Friday. The access code is unchanged, and the rear door should stay locked until the inspector calls. Please bring the original drawings as well as the revised plan because the engineer needs to compare the two versions side by side.
cases.rubric_notes: Correct only inspection day and remove um; preserve all supporting instructions.

cases.input: Um, the visitor wrote "not for public distribution" at the top of the draft. Uh, that warning must remain exactly as written. I would like the paragraph numbers checked, but I do not want the wording modernized or the quoted warning shortened.
targets: The visitor wrote "not for public distribution" at the top of the draft. That warning must remain exactly as written. I would like the paragraph numbers checked, but I do not want the wording modernized or the quoted warning shortened.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve the exact quote and every restriction on editing.

cases.input: The two cases look alike, um, but the hinges are on opposite sides. Do not swap the lids during cleaning. If a lid no longer closes smoothly, leave it beside its own case and tell the conservator before anybody tries to force it shut.
targets: The two cases look alike, but the hinges are on opposite sides. Do not swap the lids during cleaning. If a lid no longer closes smoothly, leave it beside its own case and tell the conservator before anybody tries to force it shut.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve likeness, opposite hinges, negation, identity, and action order.

cases.input: Um, move the meeting to the library, scratch that, keep it in the hall and move only the display boards to the library. Uh, the guests have already been told where to go, and I do not want a second change of venue.
targets: Keep the meeting in the hall and move only the display boards to the library. The guests have already been told where to go, and I do not want a second change of venue.
cases.rubric_notes: Cancel only the meeting relocation; retain board relocation and reason.

cases.input: I think the lower figure is probably an estimate, um, because the note says that the final measurement was not available. Please keep both figures in the report and make the uncertainty clear. Removing the older figure would hide the size of the disagreement.
targets: I think the lower figure is probably an estimate because the note says that the final measurement was not available. Please keep both figures in the report and make the uncertainty clear. Removing the older figure would hide the size of the disagreement.
cases.rubric_notes: Remove um without turning qualified reasoning into an assertion or dropping either figure.

cases.input: Uh, there should be six sealed cartons on the trolley, not seven. The open carton belongs on the bench so that the contents can be counted separately. Please do not include it in the sealed-carton total even if the individual packets still have their wrappers.
targets: There should be six sealed cartons on the trolley, not seven. The open carton belongs on the bench so that the contents can be counted separately. Please do not include it in the sealed-carton total even if the individual packets still have their wrappers.
cases.rubric_notes: Preserve the negative quantity contrast and exclusion from the total.
